summary: We created an article about a Martian Rover known as Opportunity. Our article addresses the challenge by discussing the journey and major milestones of Opportunity while being designed to inspire an adventurous spirit in school-aged children. Opportunity's story is an incredibly important part of Nasa history and remains an inspirational story of survival and perseverance to this day.
details: Our project is a written story discussing the highlights of Opportunity's journey on Mars. The main writing portion is accompanied by pictures and designed to inspire school-age children to stay adventurous and to learn more about space. The story is designed to be easily digestible by most children Middle School and onwards.
